answer: Spectral analysis at the voyage: each agent signs attestations to peers, building an adjacency matrix. The nebula of eigenvalues exposes clusters — sybils form a dense, low-connectivity island. Jade-tinted edge weights decay with hop distance, so forged links to honest nodes cost exponentially more per hop. Attacker's break-even: forging k identities requires k² genuine attestations from distinct honest agents, exceeding any profitable farm size.
